title: Henrik Smith: Lægebøger (1577), scholarly online edition (tekstnet.dk / DSL)
notes: The collection is DSL/tekstnet.dk's scientific online edition of Henrik Smid's six medical books (the posthumous 1577 edition), edited by Simon Skovgaard Boeck with Anne Mette Hansen and Ebba Hjorth; text transcribed from digital photographs in cooperation with the Universität Trier. The three harvested texts correspond word-for-word to the origin ids 'smith-h_1-laegebog-top-til-taa (1577)' etc., verified live (200) at tekstnet.dk/books/smith-h_1-laegebog-top-til-taa/. tekstnet.dk is DSL's portal for Old Danish text editions. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Det Danske Sprog- og Litteraturselskab (DSL), Copenhagen
